heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Agent
tree.text: The term “agent” means an officer or employee of a covered institution or an institution-affiliated organization.

tree.heading: Covered institution
tree.text: The term “covered institution” means any institution of higher education, as such term is defined in section 1002 of this title, that receives any Federal funding or assistance.

tree.heading: Education loan
tree.text: The term “education loan” (except when used as part of the term “private education loan”) means—

children.text: any loan made, insured, or guaranteed under part B of subchapter IV;
any loan made under part D of subchapter IV; or

tree.heading: Eligible lender
tree.text: The term “eligible lender” has the meaning given such term in section 1085(d) of this title.

children.text: is directly or indirectly related to a covered institution; and
is engaged in the practice of recommending, promoting, or endorsing education loans for students attending such covered institution or the families of such students;
may include an alumni organization, athletic organization, foundation, or social, academic, or professional organization, of a covered institution; and
notwithstanding subparagraphs (A) and (B), does not include any lender with respect to any education loan secured, made, or extended by such lender.

tree.heading: Lender
tree.text: The term “lender” (except when used as part of the terms “eligible lender” and “private educational lender”)—

children.text: in the case of a loan made, insured, or guaranteed under part B of subchapter IV, an eligible lender;
in the case of any loan issued or provided to a student under part D of subchapter IV, the Secretary; and
in the case of a private education loan, a private educational lender as defined in section 1650 of title 15; and
includes any other person engaged in the business of securing, making, or extending education loans on behalf of the lender.

tree.heading: Officer
tree.text: The term “officer” includes a director or trustee of a covered institution or institution-affiliated organization, if such individual is treated as an employee of such covered institution or institution-affiliated organization, respectively.

children.text: means an arrangement or agreement between a lender and a covered institution or an institution-affiliated organization of such covered institution—
under which a lender provides or otherwise issues education loans to the students attending such covered institution or the families of such students; and
that relates to such covered institution or such institution-affiliated organization recommending, promoting, or endorsing the education loan products of the lender; and
arrangements or agreements with respect to loans under part D of subchapter IV; or
arrangements or agreements with respect to loans that originate through the auction pilot program under section 1099d(b) of this title.

tree.heading: Private education loan
tree.text: The term “private education loan” has the meaning given the term in section 1650 of title 15.
